abnormalities.finding: Elevated right hemidiaphragm (dome ~5 cm higher than the left) with band/wedge-like increased density at the right lung base medially, silhouetting the right heart border and blunting the right cardiophrenic angle - consistent with right basal (lower lobe / middle lobe) atelectasis (the labelled finding)
Hazy rounded soft-tissue densities in the lower zones adjacent to the chest electrodes, symmetric, most likely nipple/breast shadows rather than lung nodules
Prominent bilateral breast soft-tissue shadows and obese body habitus obscuring the lower zones and cardiac silhouette; heart size cannot be reliably assessed
Gastric fundal gas with an air-fluid level beneath the left hemidiaphragm (normal, indicates upright position); left lung clear with sharp left costophrenic angle

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（記錄為PA），吸氣量不足、體型肥胖且雙側乳房陰影重疊於下肺野，另有多個心電圖電極片與導線投影於胸腹部，影像品質受限。右側橫膈明顯上抬，右下肺野內側靠近右心緣可見帶狀／楔形密度增加，右心緣與右肋膈角變模糊，符合右下肺野（右下葉／中葉基底）肺塌陷，範圍約5公分。左肺野清晰，左肋膈角銳利，左橫膈下可見胃泡氣液面；雙側下肺野於電極片附近之淡圓形陰影疑為乳頭影。未見胸管或引流管等治療證據；右側氣管旁／肺門區另見一小片長橢圓形金屬密度影，疑為外在物品。
